title: Pell's Message
summary: Pell fell carrying a message for the Association. Get him something to eat, then run the message to Quartermaster Hale.
ask: Pell: Don't. Don't touch the leg. Either leg. Don't touch either leg.
Pell: I've a message for the Association that can't wait, and I can't walk. And I haven't eaten in two days.

done: Pell: Oh, that's better. That's so much better.
Pell: Now. This letter goes to Quartermaster Hale at the High Gate. Nobody else. Run.

steps.text: Run Pell's letter to Quartermaster Hale
done: Hale: From Pell? He fell? Idiot. Brave idiot.
Hale: A gate forming where none should be. I'll send it up. Tell him he did right.

steps.text: Tell Pell the letter got through
done: Pell: Good. Good. Now I can lie here and feel sorry for myself properly.
Pell: Take my spurs. I won't need them for a while, and they're wasted on a man in a ditch.
